blocks.prompt: 1 (i) How many arrangements of the letters of the following word, taken all together, can be made? CURRICULUM
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle samajhte hain: lafz ke saare letters ek saath arrange karne hain, aur kuch letters dobara aa rahe hain.
Find kya karna hai? Kitne mukhtalif lafz (arrangements) ban sakte hain.
Plan: letters ginein, har dohraye gaye letter ki ginti karein, phir 'objects not all different' wala formula lagayen.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: lafz CURRICULUM.
Humein find karna hai: is ke tamam letters ki arrangements.
Tareeqa: Agar \(n\) cheezon mein se \(n_1\) aik jaisi hon, \(n_2\) aik jaisi hon, waghera, to un ki arrangements \(\dfrac{n!}{n_1!\,n_2! \cdots}\) hoti hain. Neeche factorial isliye lagta hai ke aik jaise letters aapas mein jagah badlein to koi naya lafz nahi banta; un adla badli ko ginti se nikalna hai.

Letters ginein
C, U, R, R, I, C, U, L, U, M
\[n = 10\]
\[\text{C} = 2,\ \text{U} = 3,\ \text{R} = 2\]
Kyun: Lafz ko letter ba letter likh kar ginna sab se mehfooz tareeqa hai. C do dafa, U teen dafa, R do dafa aaya; I, L aur M ek ek dafa hain, un ke liye 1! = 1 hai jo kuch nahi badalta.

Formula lagayen
\[\dfrac{10!}{2!\,3!\,2!} = \dfrac{3628800}{2 \cdot 6 \cdot 2}\]
\[= \dfrac{3628800}{24} = 151200\]
Kyun: Agar saare 10 letters alag hote to 10! arrangements hotin. Lekin do C aapas mein jagah badlein to lafz wahi rehta hai; isi tarah teen U aur do R. Har asal lafz 2! 3! 2! = 24 dafa gina gaya tha, is liye 24 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: U teen dafa hai, do dafa nahi; ginti mein ek letter chhoot jaye to poora jawab ghalat ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq: letters ki ginti
\[2 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har group (C, U, R, I, L, M) ki ginti jama karein to kul letters ke barabar honi chahiye. 10 aaya, yani koi letter chhoota nahi.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) How many arrangements of the letters of the following word, taken all together, can be made? ADSORPTIVELY
blocks.explanation: Pehle letters gin kar dekhte hain ke koi dohraya gaya hai ya nahi. Plan: agar koi letter repeat nahi hota to jawab seedha \(n!\) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: lafz ADSORPTIVELY.
Humein find karna hai: is ke tamam letters ki arrangements.
Tareeqa: Agar \(n\) cheezon mein se \(n_1\) aik jaisi hon, \(n_2\) aik jaisi hon, waghera, to un ki arrangements \(\dfrac{n!}{n_1!\,n_2! \cdots}\) hoti hain. Neeche factorial isliye lagta hai ke aik jaise letters aapas mein jagah badlein to koi naya lafz nahi banta; un adla badli ko ginti se nikalna hai.

Letters ginein
A, D, S, O, R, P, T, I, V, E, L, Y
\[n = 12\]
Kyun: Har letter ko ek ek kar ke dekha; koi bhi letter do dafa nahi aaya. Lamba lafz dekh kar ghabrana nahi, bas dhyan se ginna hai.

Saare letters alag hain
\[12! = 479001600\]
Kyun: Jab koi letter aik jaisa nahi to divide karne ke liye kuch nahi; 12 alag cheezon ki arrangements \({}^{12}P_{12} = 12!\) hoti hain. Pehli jagah 12 tareeqe, doosri 11, ... aakhri 1.

Tasdeeq
\[12! = 12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10 \cdot 9!\]
\[= 1320 \times 362880 = 479001600 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Exercise 7.1 se \(9! = 362880\) aur \(12 \cdot 11 \cdot 10 = 1320\); dono ka product wohi jawab deta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) How many arrangements of the letters of the following word, taken all together, can be made? PROBABILITY
blocks.explanation: Yeh part (i) jaisa sawal hai. Plan: letters ginein, dohraye gaye letters pehchanein, formula lagayen.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: lafz PROBABILITY.
Humein find karna hai: is ke tamam letters ki arrangements.
Tareeqa: Agar \(n\) cheezon mein se \(n_1\) aik jaisi hon, \(n_2\) aik jaisi hon, waghera, to un ki arrangements \(\dfrac{n!}{n_1!\,n_2! \cdots}\) hoti hain. Neeche factorial isliye lagta hai ke aik jaise letters aapas mein jagah badlein to koi naya lafz nahi banta; un adla badli ko ginti se nikalna hai.

Letters ginein
P, R, O, B, A, B, I, L, I, T, Y
\[n = 11\]
\[\text{B} = 2,\ \text{I} = 2\]
Kyun: B do dafa aur I do dafa aaya; baaqi saat letters (P, R, O, A, L, T, Y) ek ek dafa hain.

Formula lagayen
\[\dfrac{11!}{2!\,2!} = \dfrac{39916800}{4}\]
\[= 9979200\]
Kyun: \(11! = 39916800\). Do B aapas mein badlein ya do I aapas mein badlein, lafz wahi rehta hai; is liye \(2! \times 2! = 4\) se divide kiya.

Tasdeeq: letters ki ginti
\[2 + 2 + 7 \times 1 = 11 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: B ke 2, I ke 2 aur saat akele letters mil kar 11, jo kul letters hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki answer key mein chautha jawab iv) 10810800 bhi likha hai, lekin Sawal 1 mein sirf teen lafz (i)-(iii) diye gaye hain. Yeh jawab kisi bhi part se nahi milta, is liye isay nazar andaz karein.
